items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Diz got it in the hurry... Charlie Christian, Dizzy Gillespie and Charlie Parker on them... So Diz organized this group, and he had Al Haig and Stan Levy, Milt Jackson, Ray Brown and Bird.

ctx.x: He didn't fine him, either. So now, we're at Frank Daly, you know, Pee Wee's helping Benny to change, helping him to dress, rather. And Sid and I were over in another corner, watching a checker game, with our backs turned.
So Benny asked Sid, he says, "Sid," he says, "What happened with that boy, Gillespie in Cab Calloway? Sid says, mum-mum-mum-mum, and when he said that, he tore out of the dressing room.

items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: No, but Dizzy Buff saved him.

ctx.x: No, but Dizzy Buff saved him. Dizzy broke a Coca Cola bottle across his, whoever's head that was on Teddy. But everybody was fighting. So one night. --
